hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's upstream payment provider api.io-pay.example began returning HTTP 503 for /v1/shoppers/{id}/card at 15:19, and every account page render depends on that call, so error rate went to 100% and latency rose to ~2s (timeout/retry behaviour). No deploy or config change to io-shop in the prior 24 hours.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-20T15:19:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-23719-5-1/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:95
2026-09-20T15:20:00Z WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 100% over the last minute
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-19T15:19:00Z to 2026-09-20T15:19:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)
Pre-onset errors were a different, benign class: 'ClientDisconnected: the shopper closed the connection' at ~1-2%

hypotheses.summary: Alternative reading: the 503s and ~2s latency could come from io-shop exhausting its own connection/thread pool to the payment provider (a resource leak surfacing as upstream errors), though memory is flat at ~460MB of a 2GB limit and process_start_time_seconds never changes, so nothing in the metrics supports exhaustion.
